items.title: China’s development plan includes AI safety goals: Report

items.title: Italy's AI decree 179/2026 takes effect October 23 with fines up to 35 million euros
items.summary: Legislative decree no. 179 of October 7, 2026, published in the Official Gazette (Gazzetta Ufficiale) no. 234 of October 8 , takes effect on October 23 and completes Italy's transposition of the AI Act ( EU Regulation 2024/1689 on artificial intelligence).
